'''Charnoq''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was sent alongside Lord [[Ilikith (Sith Lord)|Ilikith]] to recovered the [[Black Codex]] from the [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] on the [[Star Chamber (space station)|Star Chamber]] in [[Null Zone/Legends|Null Zone]].

==Behind the scenes==
If the player decides to destroy the Codex or refuses to hand it over, Illikith and Charnoq attack the player. If the player chooses the light side dialogue, the Sith are fooled into taking the Agent's encrypted holocommunicator and depart the station. If the player spares [[Ardun Kothe]] on [[Quesh]] and later joins him on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Illikith and Charnoq are killed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
